_comment: Phishing-kit traits matched on captured HTML (src/detection/features.py: kit_traits). Each trait is a generic, documented behaviour of credential-phishing kits, not a family attribution. Families are added only with a public source per signature (field 'source'). Bump 'version' on every change; the version is recorded with each capture's features.

traits.description: Page code talks to the Telegram Bot API, a common way kits send stolen credentials to the operator.
Page code posts to a Discord webhook.
A form is handled by a third-party form backend instead of the site itself.
The page writes itself from an encoded string (atob/unescape into document.write).
Reverse-proxy toolkit header leaked in the page (see kit_fingerprint.py).
